about: The site's contracts release the publish step validates against (ADR 039 amendment of 2026-10-23; oetacademy-web ENGINE-GAPS G7). The release is private and this repository is public, so only its name and hash are kept here; lesson_package.py downloads the zip with gh and checks this sha256 every time it reads it. Upgrade deliberately: a new lock is a new ADR amendment.
